title: Telemetry Station — Weeknote (Jun 4 2028)
content:
Context / goal:
Quick sync notes from this week’s Telemetry Station sessions. Primary focus: reduce span-cardinality-driven cost while preserving signal for error triage and high-value traces. This doc is the working log for the sampling experiment, dashboard pruning changes, and immediate mitigations for the May 30 cost spike (see Jira OBS-1423).

Attendees:
- Ava Martinez (note taker)
- Marcus Li (span-sampling impl)
- Priya Nair (cost telemetry owner)
- Ethan Brooks (dashboards/alerts)
- Sofia Alvarez (SRE)
- Ad hoc: front-end rep joined for context on header-explosion flows

Top-level summary / decisions this week:
1) Immediate emergency mitigation: revert the problematic header propagation change in ingestion v2 (rolled back 2028-05-31 03:22 UTC). Reduced span-per-request from ~18 -> ~5 on average for web requests; estimated 12% week-over-week cost drop after rollback. (JIRA: OBS-1423)
2) Sampling experiment approved: staged, attribute-aware sampling (not uniform) to be rolled out to 5% of traffic on 2028-06-07, increasing to 25% / 50% / 100% over 2-week periods contingent on signal health checks. Feature flag: trace_sampling.v2.
3) Dashboard pruning: remove high-cardinality dimension heatmaps from the default infra dashboard, add a compact distribution widget + histogram aggregation to replace them. Objective: cut DB/visualization query costs by ~30%.

Data & quick numbers observed:
- Baseline (pre-incident): average spans/request = 6.3; median latency 62ms for span write pipeline.
- Incident window (2028-05-30): spikes to average 17.9 spans/request; backend write queue lag increased from 200ms -> 1.2s; ingestion cost up ~12% WoW.
- Post-rollback (2028-05-31 -> 06-02): spans/request ~5.1; write lag down to 240ms; cost trending back toward baseline but retention and sampling policy still amplify downstream query costs.

Sampling experiment design (Marcus / Priya):
- Principle: keep 100% sampling for error/failure traces and high-value routes (login, payment, embed inference requests). Use attribute-aware sampling for high-volume public routes.
- Ruleset draft (OBS-1438):
  * route=/api/v1/infer -> deterministic sampling at 10% with sticky sampling per session id
  * header X-Verbose: true -> leave unsampled (rare)
  * status >= 500 -> always sample (index for error analytics)
  * top-k spans per service per minute preserved for anomaly detection (k=50)
- Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automated quality checks after each step.
- Quality checks:
  * compare error-signal recall on recent incident signatures (we already have a baseline eval harness)
  * ensure sampling doesn’t drop >5% of unique error signatures observed historically

Risk notes:
- Overaggressive sampling can mask intermittent distributed errors (rare but high priority). To mitigate, we keep deterministic sampling for high-cardinality keys and always-sample policy on errors.
- Dashboard consumers may be surprised by apparent drop in traffic; need clear changelog and migration notes for consumer dashboards.

Dashboard work (Ethan):
- Action: create new "compact-attr-agg" widgets that pre-aggregate top-50 keys and emit a small histogram + 95th/median summary. Prototype dashboard in dev: https://grafana.redwood/obs/proto/compact-agg (internal).
- Timeline: prototype -> internal review by 2028-06-08; ship to prod by 2028-06-20 if sampling stable.
- Alerting: change high-cardinality alert thresholds to use pre-aggregated metric to avoid noisy paging.

Cost telemetry adjustments (Priya):
- Added fine-grained cost attribution by service + trace-sampling-bucket tag. This lets us measure the cost impact of each sampling tier in near-real-time.
- Short-term target: stabilize span storage costs to <6% month-over-month growth.

Runbook & playbooks (Sofia):
- Update the on-call playbook: include a new section for sampling regressions and header explosion signature. Steps: identify anomalous span-per-request > 3x baseline, triple-check recent deploy PRs touching ingestion headers, rollback candidate, enable mitigation sampling override.
- Confluence draft updated: CONFLUENCE:obs/telemetry-sampling-playbook (needs review).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Can we compress high-cardinality tag values at ingestion (hash+dictionary) without losing the ability to join on a small subset? (investigate cost/complexity tradeoffs) — Marcus to spike, due 2028-06-11.
- Is there a backend indexing/compaction window we can tune to reduce storage costs per span? (DB team sync) — Priya to coordinate with infra DB team, Jira ticket created (OBS-1442).
- UX: how do we surface sampling status to customers using private deployments? Add a per-tenant sampling policy view in the Console. Product/Console team to scope.

Action items (owner, due):
- Marcus Li: implement attribute-aware sampler prototype + PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412), initial rollout config for 5% -> 25% (due 2028-06-07).
- Priya Nair: finalize cost attribution metric and produce weekly cost delta chart for sampling buckets (due 2028-06-09).
- Ethan Brooks: dashboard prototype for compact-attr-agg + updated alert thresholds (due 2028-06-08).
- Sofia Alvarez: update on-call runbook and add new troubleshooting steps for sampling incidents (due 2028-06-06).
- Ava Martinez: assemble comparative eval report (sampling vs baseline) and circulate to cross-team stakeholders (due 2028-06-12).

Notes to self / quick fragments (informal):
- Need more telemetry around "sticky sampling" correctness (session id collisions). We should verify sampling seed is stable across retries.
- Consider a small persistent cache of top-keys per minute to ensure top-k capture consistency.
- Slack thread with raw logs: #obs-ops-thread-8k2 — contains payload examples that drove the initial spike (redact before sharing externally).

Meeting cadence / next checkpoints:
- Daily 09:30 Triage brief while rollout in progress (first week of rollout).
- Weekly Telemetry Station on Fridays 11:00 for status + retrospective.

Appendix: quick links and references:
- Incident ticket: JIRA:OBS-1423
- Sampling RFC & ruleset (draft): JIRA:OBS-1438
- Prototype PR: GITHUB:https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE:obs/telemetry-sampling-playbook

End of weeknote. Will update after first 5% rollout window finishes and we have signal metrics to compare.
